Prevention: Prompt harvesting of mature cobs to avoid infestation in the field
Clean storage places/ containers / proper sanitation
Test seeds using moisture metre; Alternatively, dry 2 times weekly for 3 hours for at most 1-2 weeks
Use clean storage materials e.g. jute bags
Use of pallets to suspend bags / containers containing seeds
Clean bin at least 2 times weekly
Monitoring: Observe for the presence of adults and eggs of weevils
Maize powder or dust on jute bags
Place ear on bags, listen for any moving sounds usually produced by weevils
Take action when signs of infestation are detected
Direct Control: Winnow the seeds and re-dry on drying floor in the sun to kill remaining eggs and adults
Use dry red chilli pepper (50 kg maize: 10 kg red chilli pepper)
Restrictions: Chlorpyrifos ethyl at the rate of 70 ml in 5 litres of water per quarter acre
